title: Entra ID & Intune Audit Telemetry to Microsoft Sentinel
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (telemetry pipeline: Entra/Intune diagnostic logs → Log Analytics → Sentinel, connectors, retention, baseline analytics).
hook: Stream identity and device audit logs into Sentinel — so nothing happens unseen
problem: Your identity and device platforms generate exactly the audit signal a SOC needs — sign-ins, directory changes, device compliance and enrollment events — but by default it's siloed in Entra ID and Intune, short-retained, and invisible to your SIEM. This solution wires Entra ID and Intune audit telemetry into Microsoft Sentinel: diagnostic settings and data connectors into Log Analytics, sensible retention, and baseline analytics so identity and endpoint activity is centralized, retained for compliance, and ready to alert on.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the telemetry pipeline (Entra ID and Intune diagnostic logs → Log Analytics workspace → Microsoft Sentinel), the relevant log categories (sign-in, audit, device/compliance), retention, and baseline analytics rules.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Azure subscription, a Log Analytics workspace, Microsoft Sentinel enabled, Entra ID and Intune diagnostic settings/connectors, retention/cost plan, RBAC) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: stand up the workspace and Sentinel, enable Entra ID diagnostic settings and the data connector, route Intune audit telemetry, set retention, enable baseline analytics rules, validate ingestion, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — telemetry-readiness discovery, ingestion/connector validation, a log-coverage and retention report, safe remediation of missing diagnostic settings, and a workspace/RBAC scoping helper.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Wire Entra ID and Intune audit telemetry into Microsoft Sentinel — diagnostic settings and connectors into Log Analytics, retention, and baseline analytics so identity and device activity is centralized, retained, and alert-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
